text_block_list.text:
While walking and discussing where to have
lunch on an outing with Marvelous Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hooo! Fuji, what are you guys up to~?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, Marvelous! I was just talking with Hishiama about what to eat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I wanna eat Western food, but Chinese is hard to pass up too.
Ah, if only I could just scarf down both at once~!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right here☆ I've got a great idea!
First, in this diary—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Party with people from all over the world was fun!"
All done! Now we get to eat all kinds of food!
choice_data_list: Did you write future plans in a diary?
Did you write future plans in a diary?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This is guaranteed to be Marvelous!
Let's go☆★ Marvelous go☆★

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Like making a wish for good luck?
Well, hope you find a good place to eat!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Marvelous reaction detected☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just look at these!
Such marvelous vegetables—

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer
text_block_list.text:
Welcome. Take your time looking around.
We're so dead today... It's driving me crazy.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?!
Even though all the veggies are so shiny and fresh!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll bring in the customers for you!
Let's spread the Marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can't just ignore someone in need.
Let me help out too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, take a loooook☆
How about some marvelous veggies~!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"Look at this sheen!
Packed with nutrition, so how about it for tonight's dinner!?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Out of thin air, behold the wonder!
This freshly squeezed carrot juice
is available for purchase right here♪

text_block_list.name: Greengrocer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at all these customers...!
Welcome! Come on in, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's still just beginning to be Marvelous☆
Mister over there, how about some vegetables~?!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Man
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
What a lively greengrocer. Let's see hereâ

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Look, these vegetables are shiny without even polishing them!
No tricks, no gimmicks here!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Man
text_block_list.text:
—Oh!? Beautiful...!!
Wonderful!!!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Anything cooked with this
is guaranteed to be marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Foreign Man
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
My chef's soul has been ignited!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Man
text_block_list.text:
I will use these vegetables in tonight's gourmet party!
Please, let me invite you all as well!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
W-What in the world?! Not only is there delicious-looking food...
there's even a Hollywood star here?!

I was supposed to be helping out at the grocery store, but before I knew it, I was part of a party...!
That's when I realized. This is—
choice_data_list: Is everything happening just like you wrote in your diary...?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, "Party with People Around the World"!
It's true, the exact same thing is happening!
What an amazing coincidence—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —It's no coincidence, you know?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "No matter what road you take, Marvelous always leads to Marvelous! That's all there is to it☆★"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
For instance, there are plenty of different
calculations to reach the answer "1," right?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
1 ÷ 1, 1 to the 999th power,
and sin²θ + cos²θ――
Different routes, but the destination is one and the same――

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: —Marvelous leads to marvelousness, you see!☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My brain is completely tangled up!
What does that actually mean!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
No need to overthink it☆
choice_data_list: Like maybe your diary has some kind of special power or something!?
Could your diary possess some kind of special power?!
Can you see the future, by any chance...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
No need to overthink it☆
choice_data_list: Like maybe your diary has some kind of special power or something!?
Could your diary possess some kind of special power?!
Can you see the future, by any chance...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: ? This diary is just the kind sold at the school store!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
It's so smooth to write with and totally marvelous☆
I totally recommend it to you too, Trainer!

Does this mean Marvelous Sunday possesses
some hidden precognitive ability?
The mystery only deepened...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it's not so much that you're seeing things,
it's that I *made* it happen, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Ah! I smell five-spice powder☆ Trainer, let's go!
Could there be some power beyond human understanding at play...? I was so preoccupied by the thought that I completely forgot to enjoy my meal.
